# TPC-DS-OBT Q12

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  item_i_item_id,
  item_i_item_desc,
  item_i_category,
  item_i_class,
  item_i_current_price,
  SUM(ext_sales_price) AS itemrevenue,
  CAST(SUM(ext_sales_price) * 100 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(ext_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY item_i_class), 0) AS revenueratio
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
WHERE
  (
    item_sk = item_i_item_sk
    AND item_i_category IN ('1', '1', '1')
    AND sold_date_sk = sold_date_d_date_sk
    AND sold_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) AND (
      CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 DAY'
    )
  )
  AND channel = 'web'
GROUP BY
  item_i_item_id,
  item_i_item_desc,
  item_i_category,
  item_i_class,
  item_i_current_price
ORDER BY
  item_i_category,
  item_i_class,
  item_i_item_id,
  item_i_item_desc,
  revenueratio
LIMIT 100
```
